name: DW Aur

paper.title: Planet-forming disks and their environment across regions and time from the full NIR census

notes: First-published SPHERE/IRDIS H-band polarimetric image (DESTINYS). A clearly inclined disk with approximate P.A. 120 deg is visible; a tentative detection of the disk back side is seen to the SW. Disk features: back side (Garufi et al. 2026, Table A.5/Fig. A.1).
